messages.subject: IID - KDE - Bandwidth
parts:
Hi Folks,

I am dealing with telemetry dataset that follow an IID movement model. My understanding on ctmm package is that using IID, it will calculate conventional KDE. Where can I find information about what is the bandwidth selection used for this?
Thanks,
Adrian

messages.author: 40fd627580dd34f5
messages.subject: Re: IID - KDE - Bandwidth
parts:
Hi Adrian,

Sorry for the delay, I had to have my appendix remove.

In current versions of the package, the IID KDE is based on the Gaussian reference function (GRF) bandwidth optimizer with an additional GRF bias correction afterwards.
  • https://esajournals.onlinelibrary.wiley.com/doi/full/10.1890/14-2010.1
  • https://besjournals.onlinelibrary.wiley.com/doi/full/10.1111/2041-210X.12673
Best,
Chris
